description: Search upcoming events in one hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco) between date_from and date_to in the hub's local calendar. Returns a compact list in time order (events without a known start time, all_day or time_unknown, at the end of their day) with at most 50 events per call (default 25); follow next_cursor for more. An event that runs several times on one day (for example 11:00, 13:00 and 15:00) is ONE item whose starts_at and occurrence_id are those of its first slot and whose slots list gives occurrence_id, starts_at and ends_at of every slot; total and paging count items. For 'when does X open' or 'when is X on' questions pass group_by='event' (with query and a date range): each event is then ONE item for the whole range with first_starts_at and last_starts_at (its first and last matching date) and occurrences_count, after all filters, plus its season over the hub calendar (up to 31 days ahead, whatever the filters): season_first_starts_at, season_last_starts_at, season_occurrences_count and the flags starts_before_range and continues_after_range, so a window inside a long run still tells when the event opens (it may run on past the data we hold); total and paging then count events. Each item has occurrence_id, title, display_title, category, starts_at (local time), all_day, time_unknown, venue, is_free, price_text (in the hub's language and currency), attend_mode, share_url (the event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page, the source to cite), age_min (a stated minimum age, null when the source states none, 0 for all ages), the audience block and tags. The audience block is null when the event is not rated; otherwise family (true: suitable for parents with children, false: not, null: unsure), adults_only (true: an adults-only event, false: not, null: unsure), visitor_pick (0 to 1, how much a first-time visitor would be glad to find it; a ranking hint, not a filter) and family_p (0 to 1, the raw family-friendly probability behind family, for your own threshold). query matches each word on its own in the title and summary (all words first, any word if none has them all; German compounds such as Halloweenparty are split); the words Kinder, Kids, Familie and family do not filter but list family events first, then the rest, each group in the requested sort. time_from and time_to (HH:MM, hub local time) keep the events that start in that range, for 'tonight' or 'in the morning'. Internal fields (editorial score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) are left out unless verbose is true. Examples: 'free events this weekend' -> free_only with the weekend dates; 'something for kids on Saturday' -> categories=['family'] for that day; 'concerts tonight' -> categories=['concert'] and time_from='18:00' for today. all_day true means the occurrence spans the whole day (starts_at is the day anchor T00:00 and it ends at least 18 hours later). time_unknown true means starts_at is only a date anchor because no showtime is known: never show 00:00, say the time is not given. Call get_event for the details of events you will mention.

categories.description: Keep only events of these category slugs (see list_categories); use ['family'] for children's and family events. An unknown slug is an error.
categories.title: Categories

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read on.
cursor.title: Cursor

date_from.description: First day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD. Not earlier than yesterday; the window to date_to is at most 31 days and ends at most 31 days from today.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Last day, inclusive, in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD; not before date_from.
date_to.title: Date To

family_friendly.description: true keeps events suitable for parents with children (audience.family true; without an audience rating: category family without a minimum age of 16 or more); false keeps the rest.
family_friendly.title: Family Friendly

free_only.description: true keeps only events known to be free.
free_only.title: Free Only

group_by.description: 'occurrence' (default) lists an event once per day, with its time slots; 'event' lists each event once for the whole date range, with first_starts_at, last_starts_at and occurrences_count of its matching dates (all filters apply first; with sort 'curation' it is placed by its best-ranked match but shows its earliest) and its season season_first_starts_at, season_last_starts_at, season_occurrences_count (all its upcoming dates in our hub calendar, up to 31 days ahead, not narrowed by the filters; the real end may lie beyond) with starts_before_range and continues_after_range. Use 'event' for 'when does X open' or 'when is X on'.
group_by.title: Group By

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco. Case-insensitive; names and abbreviations are accepted too, for example 'Hamburg', 'HH', 'München', 'Munich', 'Muenchen', 'MUC', 'Oldenburg', 'OL', 'Oldenburg (Oldb)', 'SF', 'SFO', 'San Fran' or 'San Francisco'. Results report the slug.
hub.title: Hub

max_age_min.description: Keep events with no stated minimum age or one of at most this age; 0 means no age restriction stated.
max_age_min.title: Max Age Min

query.description: Words to look for in title and summary, each matched on its own (case-insensitive; all words, else any word). Kinder, Kids, Familie and family list family events first (then the rest, each group in the requested sort) instead of filtering.
query.title: Query

sort.description: 'time' lists chronologically (default), events without a known start time at the end of their day; 'curation' lists the editorially ranked best first (equal ranks in time order). 'start' and 'date' are accepted as 'time'.
sort.title: Sort

time_from.description: Keep events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours). Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are dropped when a time is given. With a time_to before time_from the range wraps past midnight.
time_from.title: Time From

time_to.description: Keep events that start at or before this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours). See time_from. A range that wraps past midnight (time_from after time_to) applies to the start time of each day of the window.
time_to.title: Time To

venue.description: Venue name or town; matches the venue name as shown in results, so a town name keeps every venue in that town.
venue.title: Venue

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.
verbose.title: Verbose

name: search_events

Audience.description:
The pre-computed audience verdict of one event (docs/specs/mcp-public.md).

``family`` and ``adults_only`` are the routed booleans (null when neither
the model nor a rule decides); ``family_p`` is the raw family-friendly
probability so a caller can set its own threshold; ``visitor_pick`` is a
0..1 ranking hint, not a filter.
Audience.title: Audience

Curation.description: The compact curation verdict of one event (docs/specs/event-curation.md).
Curation.title: Curation

SearchItem.description:
One compact record of ``search_events``: an event on one day, or with
``group_by="event"`` an event over the whole window. The item's own
``occurrence_id`` and ``starts_at`` are those of its first slot (first match).
SearchItem.title: SearchItem

SlimSignals.description: The one signal a search item carries.
SlimSignals.title: SlimSignals

Slot.description: One time slot of an event on one day.
Slot.title: Slot

title: Search events
